meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files). Triggers include: any mention of "Word doc", "word document", ".docx", or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a "report", "memo", "letter", "template", or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以创建、读取、编辑和操作 Word 文档（.docx 文件），包括添加目录、页眉页脚、表格、图片、修订和批注。
howto.when: 当你提到“Word 文档”、“.docx”或要求生成报告、备忘录、信件等专业文档时触发。也用于提取或修改 .docx 文件内容。

say.text: 帮我创建一个带目录和页眉的 Word 文档。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个 .docx 文件。

say.text: 把这个 .docx 文件里的“30天”改成“60天”。
say.note: Claude 会编辑文档并保留修订标记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, read, edit, and manipulate Word documents (.docx files), including adding tables of contents, headers/footers, tables, images, tracked changes, and comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Word doc", ".docx", or request a report, memo, letter, etc. Also used for extracting or modifying .docx content.

say_en.text: Create a Word document with a table of contents and header.
Change "30 days" to "60 days" in this .docx file.
say_en.note: Claude will edit the document with tracked changes.
